title: Senior Manager Product Solution Owner
description: The Senior Manager Product Solution Owner serves as the Product Manager and IT Lead for customer- and consumer-facing capabilities, including ordering, production execution planning, order changes, order fulfillment, digital engagement and notifications, to drive efficient consumer/customer/supplier alignment and high satisfaction with the path to purchase. Working out of the Milwaukee, WI office, this leader bridges technical delivery teams, business stakeholders, and voice of the customer to design, enhance, and sustain IT solutions. The position is accountable for optimizing enterprise value by balancing prioritized features, costs, timeline, technical debt, and data considerations. In the near term, the role acts as IT lead within a broader SAP/ERP transformation program, partnering with a business lead and solution integration partner leader to deliver a transformed wholesaler ordering process and user experience. Over time, the role will oversee other products, such as digital marketing, establishing roadmaps and a clear product vision to deliver against objectives and key results (OKRs).
salary: $129,900.00 - $170,500.00 (posting salary range) + 20% target short term incentive + $12,500 + 400 Non-Qualified Stock Options target long term incentive + $23,000 on average spent on benefits per employee, including but not limited to health, dental, vision, retirement with above market employer match, wellness incentives and EAP + paid time off (including holidays, vacation days and sick days). The salary posting range is what Molson Coors, in good faith, believes it would pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual pay is based on non-discriminatory factors including required work location, previous work experience, skill set and internal equity.
responsibilities: Serve as Product Manager and IT Lead for customer- and consumer-facing capabilities, including ordering, production execution planning, order changes, order fulfillment, digital engagement and notifications.

Bridge technical delivery teams, business stakeholders, and voice of the customer to design, enhance, and sustain IT solutions; optimize enterprise value by balancing prioritized features, costs, timeline, technical debt, and data considerations.

Act as IT lead within a broader SAP/ERP transformation program, partnering with a business lead and solution integration (SI) partner leader to deliver a transformed wholesaler ordering process and user experience.
Over time, oversee other products such as digital marketing, establishing roadmaps and a clear product vision to deliver against objectives and key results (OKRs).

Lead cross-functional product teams bridging agile (Salesforce.com/o9 Solutions) and waterfall (SAP) delivery methodologies to drive design, development, and delivery of the new B2B customer ordering experience.
Deliver and scale consumer/customer technology solutions while informing and supporting the rationalization of legacy tools.
Support functional leaders in change management and user adoption of delivered solutions to ensure value is delivered.

Own and manage requirements and product backlogs, prioritizing work against fixed timelines and budgets; ensure successful end-to-end product delivery including design, development, testing, UAT, and deployment, partnering with the IT department and solution integration partners.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree OR equivalent experience in technology leadership or IT.
5+ years of Product Management, Product Development, Business Strategy.
Previous experience in a business partnering role or product leadership role.
Experience delivering technology solutions including business-specific and enterprise applications in alignment with business objectives.
Experience leading cross-functional product teams in the Manufacturing or Consumer Products industry.
Experience implementing and utilizing agile and waterfall methodologies for development in a technology organization.
Accountability for results, integrity, and honoring commitments.
Thirst for learning and continuous improvement.
Alignment with the company’s core values.
Experience with SAP, Salesforce.com, digital marketing solutions, and/or o9 Solutions a strong plus.
workArrangement: Working out of the Milwaukee, WI office. Flexible work programs support work life balance, including a hybrid work model of 4 days in the office.
benefits: Engagement with a variety of Business Resource Groups, which can provide volunteer opportunities, leadership experience, and networking through the organization.
Career growth and development centered around First Choice Learning opportunities.

Total Rewards program with a competitive base salary, incentive plans, parental leave, health, dental, vision, retirement plan options with employer match, generous paid time off plans, a Wellness Program, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
On site Pub (delete if not applicable), access to brand clothing and swag, top events, and free beer and beverages.
companyCulture: Molson Coors has a portfolio of beer, seltzers, spirits, and non-alcohol brands and seeks curious, tenacious individuals who are willing to fail forward. The company values unique perspectives and experiences, collaboration, and celebrating team successes. It describes a fast paced and innovative workplace with colleagues and partners from diverse backgrounds and experiences, stretch goals around People and Planet priorities, and community involvement through charitable donations and activities such as building parks.
selectionConditions: Employees identified through the succession planning process as ‘Ready Now’ will be considered first. Those identified as Ready in Time or who are not formally on a succession plan will be considered in conjunction with external applicants if a ‘Ready Now’ successor is not appointed.
equalOpportunity: Molson Coors is an equal opportunity employer. Applications are invited from candidates of all backgrounds, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic.
accommodations: Candidates with a disability who believe they need a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruitment processes should email jobs@molsoncoors.com.
